Decides whether the weather postpones a match: only the home club's league matches at an uncovered stadium, outside the end of the key nation's season; by the evening slot and by the weather. \n `Weather::check_postponement(match)`, from the match day (0x6b3c10) and from the match preparation (0x6b7f20). Without a stadium (+0x18) with a city (+0x38) and places (+0x3c), without a competition (+0x14), with the home club (+0x1c) outside a league (+0x57) or the match outside its league, or a covered stadium (+0x4c): 0. In the home club's key nation (0x669360, table 0xb63d60 of 0x48 bytes), near the end of the year's season (+0x39/+0x3b): 0. In the evening slot (+0x3f = 2), by the home club's finances (0x5a0590, band 0x5986b0): random(1000/2500/5000) zero returns 0x12. Then the match weather (0x923010, written into the argument's slot as in the original): rain 5 at 1 to 13 degrees, an uncovered stadium (+0x4d) of up to 20000 places: a random draw by places and home club (+0x64), zero = 9 (postponement); rain 8 (up to 15000 places) and 9 (ice; by wind 4 and by 10000 places): a chain of random draws that returns 0, 5 or 6.

Returns the finance record (0x167 bytes) by the club id; for a B club with an A partner, the A one (0x540a50); null club, error box. \n `FinanceTable::get_club_finance(club)` (finance.cpp): the finance record (0x167 bytes at [this]) of the club by id (+0); a B club with an A partner (0x540a50 with the returned byte 0): the A one's. Null club: the "Error" box of finance.CPP (as in the original).

Returns the match weather: wind (0..4), rain (0, 1, 2, 3, 5), temperature and its band, from the city, its region and the period by the day; below zero, the rain becomes snow/ice (6..9). \n `Weather::get_match_weather(out, match)`, in the match preparation (0x6b7f20, at +0x4756 of the engine: the wind weighs on long shots), in the postponement (0x923630) and in the screens. Without regions ([this], [this + 8]): nothing. The city: the stadium's (+0x18 → +0x38), otherwise that of the home club's stadium (+0x1c → +0x69 → +0x38), otherwise the capital of its nation (+0x53 → +0x7a). With a city: out[3] = the city's wind (table [this + 4], 4 bytes per city, byte 3) and its region (otherwise that of the nation's capital +0x1f, otherwise the first). The period by the match day (+0x2a; without a match, the game day) against the region's limits +0x1e/+0x31/+0x44/+0x57 (3, 0, 1, 2, 3); in the period (19 bytes from +0x20): out[0] = wind by the city's reading 2 (+0x20..+0x24: 0..4), out[1] = rain by reading 1 (+0x25..+0x29: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5), and the temperature band by reading 2 (+0x2a..+0x30: 1, 0, 2..6, otherwise 3). Without a city: out[3], [0] and [1] = 0 and band 2. out[2] = the temperature (0x9232c0); below zero, the rain becomes snow/ice: 1 → 6, 2 and 3 → 6/7/8 and 5 → 8/7/9 by the city's wind 0/1/other.

Returns the match temperature: (day × band) modulo 6/7/8 plus the band base (−5 to 35; other band −100); in the evening slot, − 2 below 10, otherwise × 0.8. \n `Weather::get_temperature(band, match)`, from the match weather. With the day d (of the match +0x2a, unsigned; without a match, the game day) and x = d × band: band 0: x % 6 + 1; 1: x % 6 − 5; 2: x % 7 + 7; 3: x % 8 + 14; 4: x % 7 + 22; 5: x % 6 + 29; 6: x % 6 + 35; other: −100. A match in the evening slot (+0x3f = 2): below 10, − 2; otherwise × 0.8 truncated. (It reads the match's +0x3f even without a match, as the original does.)

Returns the pitch condition from the rain, the temperature, the stadium flag and places and a fixture remainder modulo 20: 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 0x10, 0x20 or 0x40; covered stadium, 0. \n `Weather::get_pitch_condition(weather, match)`, in the match preparation (0x6b7f20, at +1 of the engine: pitch 2 and 0x20 weigh on shots). Without a match, without a stadium (+0x18) or a covered stadium (+0x4c): 0. h = (day +0x2a + +0x10 + +0xc + +0) % 20. By the rain weather[1] and the temperature weather[2] (1 to 28 degrees), with the stadium flag +0x4d and the places +0x3c: rain 5: 2/1 or 8/1; rain 1: 2 or 0 by h < 6/4; rain 2 and 3: by h < 4/1/3; rain 4: 2 or 1/2; below 1 degree, rain 1 and 8: 2, 0x10 or 1; rain 9: 2, 1 or 0x20/1; no rain at 29 degrees or more: 0x40 or 4; otherwise 0.

Updates each city's weather daily: the three readings become (reading + random(100)) × 0.5, clamped to 0..100; one time in ten, a new wind = random(3). \n `Weather::update_city_weather()`, every day from the game's day loop (0x5cd9aa, [0xde2f74]). Without the city table (+4, 4 bytes per city): nothing. Each city ([0xae2354], re-read on every loop): the three readings (+0, +1, +2) become (reading + random(100)) × 0.5 truncated, clamped to 0..100; random(10) zero gives the new wind (+3) = random(3).

Reads one weather.cfg line with the region id and name ("%ld %s") and its four periods (0x922d20) at +0x1e, +0x31, +0x44 and +0x57. \n `Weather::read_region(f, region)`: one line of weather.cfg (0x90cba0, buffer of 2000) with "%ld %s" (0xad4e24) into the id (+0) and the name (+4) of the region (0x6e bytes); then the four periods (0x922d20) at +0x1e, +0x31, +0x44 and +0x57. Returns 1 if it read everything (only al, as in the original).

Reads one line with the name and 18 integers (the day, five W, five P, seven H): the period gets the day (word) and the 17 bytes; a null file gives the "Error" box. \n `Weather::read_region_period(f, period)`: a null file gives the "Error" box (weather.cpp, 0xea) and 0. One line (0x90cba0) with the format at 0xad4e2c (the name and 18 integers: the day, five W, five P and seven H); with all 19 read, the period (0x13 bytes) receives the day (word at +0) and the next 17 bytes (+2..+0x12). Returns 1 if read (only al).

Reads CM3_DATA\weather.cfg: the region count, the regions (0x922c40) and the city table, with the three readings and the wind drawn at random; a file or memory error stops the game. \n `Weather::load_config()`, on game creation (0x9226c0, Setup.cpp). Opens CM3_DATA\weather.cfg (0x90bde0, fopen 0x945b00 "r"); the first line (0x90cba0, buffer of 1000) gives how many regions ("%ld" into +8); the regions (malloc of 0x6e bytes each at +0) and the city table (malloc of 4 bytes per city [0xae2354] at +4); each region through 0x922c40 (the first that fails stops the game; the others only end the reading); each city draws the three readings ((random(100) + random(100)) × 0.5) and the wind (random(3)). Closes the file (0x945a09). The errors (file, line, count, memory) give the "Error" box of weather.cpp and the game stops.
